settings.siteNameDescription: Name shown at the top of the website. Leave blank for default.
settings.openRegistrationDescription: Allow anyone to create an account without an invite code.
settings.maintenanceModeDescription: Block everyone except admins from logging in.
settings.sessionDurationDescription: How many days users stay logged in before needing to sign in again.
settings.avatarsEnabledDescription: Let users set a profile picture. If turned off, everyone gets letter icons.
settings.maxAvatarSizeDescription: Largest file size allowed for profile pictures.
settings.allowAvatarUrlDescription: Let users paste a direct image link for their profile picture.
settings.defaultMaxLibraryBytesDescription: Storage limit per user. Leave blank for unlimited.
settings.invalidSessionDuration: Login duration must be between 1 and 365 days.
settings.invalidMinPasswordLength: Minimum password length must be a valid number.
settings.invalidMaxAvatarBytes: Max picture size must be a positive number.
settings.invalidDefaultMaxLibraryBytes: Default storage limit must be a positive number or blank.
settings.invalidSmtpPort: SMTP Port must be between 1 and 65535 or blank.
settings.invalidPublicAppUrl: Website URL must start with http:// or https://
settings.groupGeneralDescription: Basic details about this server and who can join it.
settings.groupNetworkDescription: How this server is reached, and which other sites may talk to it.
settings.publicAppUrlDescription: The web address of this site. Used to build email links for password resets.
settings.allowedOriginsDescription: Websites allowed to talk to this server. Separate with commas. Leave blank if unsure.
settings.groupNsfwDescription: Decide which tags, words and symbols mark a title as adult content.
settings.nsfwGenreTagsDescription: Click a tag to flag it as adult content (NSFW).
settings.nsfwKeywordsDescription: Keywords to flag titles without tags. Separate with commas.
settings.nsfwSymbolsDescription: If a tag contains any of these symbols, it will be flagged.
settings.nsfwConfirmEmpty: This will clear the entire list. Are you sure?
settings.nsfwImportInvalid: That file isn't a valid settings export.
settings.groupSecurityDescription: How long people stay signed in, and how strong their passwords must be.
settings.groupAvatarsDescription: Whether people can set a profile picture, and how large it may be.
settings.groupLibraryDescription: How much space each person's synced library is allowed to use.
settings.groupEmailDescription: Required to send password reset emails. Leave blank if you don't want to use email.
settings.smtpSecureDescription: Turn on for Port 465. Turn off for Port 587 or 25.
settings.smtpFromDescription: Email address shown as the sender on automated emails.
settings.testEmailDescription: Send a test message to check if your settings work.
